hero.title: Refund Policy
hero.description: Clear rules for deposits, milestone payments, and recurring plans — so there are no surprises if plans change.

overview.title: 1. Overview
overview.body: This Refund Policy explains how payments are handled if a project is cancelled, paused, or doesn't meet expectations. It sits alongside our Service Agreement; where the two conflict, the signed proposal or statement of work controls.

deposits.title: 2. Deposits
deposits.body: Project deposits are non-refundable. Deposits reserve capacity on our schedule and cover discovery, strategy, and initial design work that begins as soon as you sign off.

milestones.title: 3. Milestone Payments
list_items: Milestone payments cover work already completed and approved. Payments for delivered milestones are non-refundable.
If you cancel mid-project, you're responsible for work completed and expenses incurred through the cancellation date. Any pre-paid amount above that is refunded within 14 business days.

recurring.title: 4. Recurring Plans (Care, Hosting, Retainers)
list_items: Recurring plans are billed monthly in advance and are non-refundable for the current month.
You can cancel at any time with 30 days' written notice. Service continues through the paid period; no further charges occur after cancellation is effective.
Unused hours in a monthly retainer do not roll over and are not refundable.

third_party.title: 5. Third-Party Fees
third_party.body: Fees paid to third-party providers on your behalf — domains, hosting, stock media, premium plugins, ad spend — are non-refundable once purchased, regardless of project status.

chargebacks.title: 6. Chargebacks
chargebacks.body: Please contact us before initiating a chargeback. We'll work to resolve any concern quickly. Chargebacks filed without prior notice may result in immediate suspension of services and are treated as a material breach of our agreement.

request.title: 7. How to Request a Refund
request.body: Send a written request through our contact page with your project name, invoice number, and reason. Eligible refunds are processed to the original payment method within 14 business days of approval.

changes.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
changes.body: We may update this Refund Policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date above reflects the current version.

cta.title: Need to talk about a refund?
cta.description: Reach out first — we'll work with you to make it right.
